# auth_access

:::info[Typed specification]

Generated by the pinned `ess generate --kind docs` from [`ess`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/ess). Structural validation establishes consistency; behaviour, storage and cross-record predicates remain implementation obligations.

:::

Proposed access selection, acquisition declaration and exact permission-budget values; no runtime or persistent owner.

`connectors.auth_access` is one of connectors's bounded contexts. [Back to the index](../index.md).

## Types

### `AccessMode`

`connectors.auth_access.AccessMode` is one of `credential`, `direct_anonymous` and `parent_authenticated`.

### `AccessSelection`

`connectors.auth_access.AccessSelection` is a record of seven fields:

- `profile` — `String`
- `mode` — `connectors.auth_access.AccessMode`
- `purpose` — `connectors.auth_access.Purpose`
- `subject` — `connectors.auth_access.Subject`
- `scheme` — `connectors.auth_access.Scheme`
- `flow` — `connectors.auth_access.AcquisitionFlow`
- `capability` — `connectors.auth_access.CapabilityName`

Every value satisfies `(not (mode == direct_anonymous) or (purpose == anonymous and subject == none and scheme == none and flow == static_config and capability == http-anonymous))` and `(not (mode == parent_authenticated) or (purpose == mediated_access and subject == none and scheme == parent and flow == static_config and capability == mediated-http))`.

### `AcquisitionDeclaration`

`connectors.auth_access.AcquisitionDeclaration` is a record of eight fields:

- `flow` — `connectors.auth_access.AcquisitionFlow`
- `authorize_url` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `token_url` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `pkce` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `registration_kind` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `callback_binding` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `grants` — `List<String>`
- `sources` — `List<String>`

### `AcquisitionFlow`

`connectors.auth_access.AcquisitionFlow` is one of `static_config`, `static_entry`, `oauth2_authorization_code`, `oauth2_client_credentials`, `oauth2_password`, `workload_identity`, `exec_plugin` and `host_issued`.

### `AuthorizationCoverage`

`connectors.auth_access.AuthorizationCoverage` is a record of two fields:

- `complete` — `Boolean`
- `targets` — `List<connectors.auth_access.AuthorizationTarget>`

Every value satisfies `targets.count <= 64` and `(complete == false or forall t in targets: (t.result == allowed))`.

### `AuthorizationResult`

`connectors.auth_access.AuthorizationResult` is one of `allowed` and `denied`.

### `AuthorizationTarget`

`connectors.auth_access.AuthorizationTarget` is a record of two fields:

- `target` — `connectors.auth_access.PermissionTarget`
- `result` — `connectors.auth_access.AuthorizationResult`

### `CapabilityName`

`connectors.auth_access.CapabilityName` is one of `http-bearer`, `http-basic`, `http-signing`, `http-anonymous`, `mtls-client-identity`, `socket-peer`, `exec-credential-plugin`, `sip-credential-lease`, `session-authority`, `inbound-verifier` and `mediated-http`.

### `PermissionBudget`

`connectors.auth_access.PermissionBudget` is a record of four fields:

- `target_limit` — `Integer`
- `call_limit` — `Integer`
- `concurrency_limit` — `Integer`
- `deadline` — `Timestamp`

Every value satisfies `(target_limit >= 0 and target_limit <= 64)`, `(call_limit >= 0 and call_limit <= 64)` and `(concurrency_limit >= 0 and concurrency_limit <= 4)`.

### `PermissionObservation`

`connectors.auth_access.PermissionObservation` is a record of three fields:

- `target` — `connectors.auth_access.PermissionTarget`
- `result` — `connectors.auth_access.PermissionResult`
- `cached` — `Boolean`

### `PermissionResult`

`connectors.auth_access.PermissionResult` is one of `allowed`, `denied` and `unavailable`.

### `PermissionTarget`

`connectors.auth_access.PermissionTarget` is a record of two fields:

- `binding_ref` — `String`
- `target_ref` — `String`

### `Purpose`

`connectors.auth_access.Purpose` is one of `service_account`, `delegated_user`, `app_level`, `inbound_verification`, `transport_identity`, `trunk_registration`, `anonymous` and `mediated_access`.

### `Scheme`

`connectors.auth_access.Scheme` is one of `http_bearer`, `http_basic`, `http_signing`, `mtls`, `socket_peer`, `exec_plugin`, `sip_digest`, `session_authority`, `none` and `parent`.

### `Subject`

`connectors.auth_access.Subject` is one of `app`, `user` and `none`.

Four of the types above are reached by nothing else in this system: `connectors.auth_access.AccessSelection`, `connectors.auth_access.AuthorizationCoverage`, `connectors.auth_access.PermissionBudget` and `connectors.auth_access.PermissionObservation`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names them, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
